entry.title: Services
entry.content:
Ambassador

I have a few services on my Hetzner VPS/Cloud, its hostname is ambassador after the Ambassador-class starships in Star Trek (all my hostnames are Star Trek starship classes).

I run on this server:

  • A Git Forge as well as a runner
  • A conduwuit (matrix server) instance (faefox.dev)
  • An instance of Cinny (matrix client)
  • A service status page

CloudFare Page

I use CloudFare Page to run a few static websites.

  • Personal Web and Blog
  • Writing Web, Blog, and Online Reader (SOON)
  • Calc Web

Migadu

I use Migadu as my email provider. I use the micro yearly plan, for only $20 USD a year I have everything I need. I have emails under the following domains.

  • charlotte-thomas.me
  • me
  • gc
  • faefox.dev
  • me
  • nwa2coco.fr (to be deleted on May 2025)
  • charlotte

NAS

I have a NAS (2TB on RAID1) running on my local network. Its name is Olympic (because it is old, big, and vulnerable)

I have twice daily backups using restic on it.

Hostnames

  • My personal laptop is Defiant (because it’s tough, and little)
  • My work laptop is Galaxy (because it’s big)
  • My personal phone is Danube (because it’s small)
  • My NAS is Olympic
  • My VPS is Ambassador

Plans for the future

In the future, when I have my own home, with my own Network (because I am moving to a place where I don’t control it for the moment), my plan is to run a Server/NAS where I can store my data and expose it to the web to run my applications and everything I need

In the plans there is:

  • Everything I run on my VPS
  • A NAS (maybe with TrueNAS?)
  • A NextCloud
  • A web equivalent to Google Docs/Google Sheets
  • A Plex Server
  • An OpenStack instance (to do ansible and terraform on)
  • And everything that strike my fancy

The budget will be around €1,500 to build it, and the minimum spec I want are:

  • CPU: 8C/16T, reasonably recent
  • GPU: An Intel ARC for transcoding
  • RAM: 64GB
    • 32GB for the NAS
    • 32GB for the VMs
  • Storage:
    • 8TB in RAID5 with HDD
    • 512GB in RAID1 on NVMe
  • PSU:
    • Gold Rated Unit
    • An UPS
  • Silent Fans.
  • LAN: 2.5 Gbit/s

I don’t know if I want to run it on a rack or not. I think not.

Everything is very subject to changes. It’s the early version of what I’m thinking. I may scrap it and run it from an old motherboard because I would have updated my Framework. Maybe. So it can change it’s just what I’m feeling at the moment.

It won’t exists for another year and a half (or more); but it will probably be under some subdomains of charlotte-thomas.me and/or faefox.dev

entry.title: Setup Showcase
entry.content:
Hardware

I am a laptop as a Desktop kind of girl. I use my laptop docked the vast majority of the time.

  • Laptop: Framework 13
    • CPU: AMD Ryzen 5 7640U 6C/12T
    • GPU: AMD Radeon 760M
    • RAM: 1x32Go 5600MT/s DDR5
    • Storage: Lexar 512Go NVMe SSD
    • Screen:
      • Size: 13.5“
      • Resolution: 2880x1920
      • Refresh Rate: 120Hz
      • Scale: 2
      • Addition; Matte anti-glare
    • Battery: 61Wh (capped at 80% for battery preservation)
    • Modules:
      • 1x USB-C 4.0 (top right)
      • 1x DP (top left)
      • 1x USB-C 3.2 (bottom left)
      • 1x USB-A 3.2 (bottom right)
  • Screen: Dell
    • Size: 27“
    • Resolution: 2560x1440
    • Refresh Rate: Up to 180Hz (capped at 120Hz for consistency)
    • Scale: 1.25
  • Input:
    • Apple MagicTrackpad USB-C
    • Keychron K4 Pro QMK
      • Switches: Brown (with one green)
  • 2FA: Two Yubikey 5C NFC

Software

Here are the different softwares I use, for more information see the git page README

  • OS: Fedora Linux Workstation 41
  • WM: Niri on Wayland
    • Almost stock configuration
  • Bar: Waybar
  • Terminal: Alacritty
    • Font: Monaspace Xenon 9pt
  • Shell: fish
    • fzf-pass: a fish function for pass
    • fzf-browse: a fish function to browse files and open them
  • Prompt: Starship
    • Modified pure prompt
  • App Launcher: Rofi
    • Colour scheme: Catppuccin Mocha
  • Lock: Hyprlock
    • With fingerprint
  • Editor: neovim
    • LazyVim
    • Mason for LSPs
    • Lots of plugins
  • Docking handler: kanshi
  • Containers: Podman
    • Language Tool Server
  • Session Manager: GDM
  • Finance: GNUCash
  • Passwords: KeepassXC & pass
  • Backups: Restic

entry.title: Hello World!
entry.content:
Intro

Welcome to my blog!

I have been running a writing blog for quite some time now but I thought it was finally time to restart my general blog!

Content

Here you will find, amongst other things.

  • Software I discovered
  • Hardware (rarer)
  • Linux configuration
  • Gay/LGBTI+ shit
  • And whatever I want to write

What you won’t find though (except for some announcements) are any news about my writing. All the writing stuff is on my writing page

Services

You can see the services I run on the uptime page.

At the moment of writing I run:

On my Hetzner server

  • A forgejo instance and runner
  • A Conduwuit matrix server (faefox.dev)
  • A Cinny matrix client instance

On CloudFare page

  • This website and blog
  • The writing website and blog
  • Calc’s website

Roadmap
